details.label: Discussion
details.text: Thunderstorms across southern Wisconsin have taken on a more linear/bowing mode over the last hour. The line has produced a few instances of damaging wind, with measured gusts up to 61 mph. Deep layer flow is largely westerly, which will likely push the line eastward across southern Wisconsin through the evening with damaging wind becoming the main threat. Watch issuance further south of WW595 remains uncertain. Deep layer flow decreases further south, with mid-level cloud cover in place and less instability. Additionally, lapse rate profiles are meager. A couple of cells have developed further west across far eastern Iowa. These may pose some potential for large hail in the short term. It remains uncertain that coverage/duration will warrant additional watch issuance at this time but this area will be monitored
